title: Free Printable Numbers Chart
summary: Help your little one learn to count from 1 through 10 with this free printable numbers chart by Once Upon a Farm, featuring their favorite foods
body_markdown:
Ready, set, count! Support early number recognition and counting skills with our free printable numbers chart. Designed to help kids identify numbers 1 through 10, this visual tool pairs familiar fruits, veggies, and everyday foods with each number to make learning approachable and fun.


Download our free PDF below and start counting together in no time!


## Free Printable Numbers Chart for Kids


### Printing Instructions:


1. [Click this link to download PDF file](https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/1889/4791/files/Once_Upon_a_Farm_Printable_Numbers_Chart_9c1bb214-9234-494f-850b-6bdedf549140.pdf?v=1768491751) .
2. Print the file as a full-color page.
